en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a wooden railway station building surrounded by trees. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit along the platform, including several children in hats and dresses. Railway tracks run in the foreground. A large signboard on the building advertises goods, and printed text at the top of the image reads "Rönninge Järnvägsstation."
